title: Senior Principal NetSuite Functional Consultant
jobDescription:
Minimum 10+ years of ERP consulting experience with 7+ years of Net Suite implementation experience, including 5+ years leading end-to-end Net Suite ERP implementation projects. * Full lifecycle Net Suite ERP implementation experience including Discovery, Solution Design, Configuration, Testing (SIT/UAT), Go-Live, Hypercare, and Support Transition. * Lead multiple Net Suite implementation projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-volume consulting environment. * Serve as the primary customer-facing Functional Lead, managing executive stakeholders and driving solution governance. * Strong understanding of Net Suite ERP, Suite Cloud platform, integrations, and Oracle implementation methodologies. * Deep functional knowledge of Finance, SCM, CRM, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Design to Build, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report and Lead to Quote business processes. * Experience in at least one industry vertical and ability to recommend industry-leading practices and scalable business solutions. * Lead onshore/offshore functional and technical teams, providing mentoring, guidance, and delivery oversight. * Own solution quality, project risks, scope, issue resolution, and change management throughout the engagement lifecycle. * Collaborate with Project Managers, Solution Architects, Technical Consultants, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful project delivery. * Experience delivering Saa S and Paa S solutions, including third-party integrations and ERP extensions. * Support pre-sales activities including solution workshops, effort estimation, RFP/RFI responses, and customer presentations. * Contribute to practice development through reusable assets, best practices, knowledge sharing, and consultant mentoring. * Net Suite certifications (ERP Consultant, Suite Foundation) are highly preferred. * CA/CPA/MBA or equivalent business qualification is an added advantage. Also must be well versed with AI tools. * Excellent customer-facing, presentation, communication, stakeholder management, and business writing skills. * Strong analytical, problem-solving, project governance, and financial management capabilities. * Demonstrated ability to influence customer decisions, manage executive escalations, and deliver successful business outcomes. A highly competent Principal Functional Consultant with extensive experience in delivering enterprise-wide Net Suite business solutions and driving complex ERP implementations. This role is responsible for leading multiple concurrent customer engagements, providing functional leadership, ensuring delivery excellence, and acting as a trusted advisor to customers. The Principal Consultant will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time, within budget, and in accordance with Oracle delivery methodologies and contractual commitments. As a Principal Consultant, you will be expected to own end-to-end project delivery, manage multiple customer engagements in parallel, provide functional leadership, mentor consulting teams, and consistently deliver successful customer outcomes aligned with Oracle quality and delivery standards. Principal Consultant Expectations As a Principal Consultant, you will own the successful delivery of multiple end-to-end Net Suite implementation projects while maintaining delivery excellence across quality, schedule, scope, budget, and customer satisfaction. You will act as the primary customer-facing functional leader, providing strategic guidance throughout the engagement lifecycle and ensuring alignment with Oracle Consulting standards and industry best practices. The role requires balancing multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced, high-volume consulting environment while effectively leading cross-functional onshore and offshore teams, mentoring consultants, managing executive stakeholders, driving governance, mitigating delivery risks, and ensuring successful customer outcomes. In addition to project delivery, the Principal Consultant is expected to contribute to practice growth through mentoring, solution innovation, reusable assets, delivery excellence initiatives, and support for pre-sales and business development activities. Career Level
- IC3

title: Principal Data Systems Software Engineer
jobDescription:

These range from initial provisioning of the customer’s database and compute environment to complete life-cycle management of the customer’s database instance on the Oracle Public Cloud. The Database on Public Cloud products are growing rapidly, and the product features are designed to manage customer environments at a massive scale. Expertise in writing well-modularized, maintainable software. Excellent interpersonal skills in both technical and non-technical contexts Experience building cloud-based platforms that enable application design, development, testing, and distribution. Strong troubleshooting and performance-tuning skills We are seeking highly motivated engineers with strong systems expertise to join our Database Cloud Services Platform Development team. AI enablement/development for SRE/Ops and Developer productivity Work closely with senior developers, Product Management, IT, and Operations teams for the complete SDLC of the database cloud product Participate in transformational projects to deliver scalable, extensible, and differentiated Platform-as-a-Service on the Cloud. title: Sales Director-Tech Cloud
jobDescription:
In this role, you will drive the adoption of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) across customers Iaa S and Paa S environments, including distributed, public, and private cloud portfolios for strategic accounts like Airtel, Indus, EXL. You will help customers solve critical business challenges—such as accelerating decision-making with AI-powered insights or meeting demanding service-level expectations—by delivering strategic cloud solutions that drive measurable outcomes. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of all OCI products and services; sales experience in the enterprise software space, and a passion for helping clients succeed through applying innovative technology. You would have solid expertise selling to C-suite, engineering, and Dev Ops, and be familiar with open source and other cloud tools (such as Dockers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Linux, Java) We are seeking motivated individuals with a strong "hunter and challenger" mindset who excel at opening new markets, developing territories, and growing existing accounts. You will create exceptional customer experiences that result in long-term partnerships, contract renewals, and expanded cloud adoption. Are you passionate about helping organisations, including enterprises and government entities achieve better outcomes? If so, we’d love to hear from you. If you're ready to take the next step in your career by delivering world-class, effective, efficient, and commercially viable solutions, one of our Oracle Cloud sales roles could be your path to success. We’re expanding our Cloud Sales team and are looking for enthusiastic self-starters who are customer-focused and driven to make an impact. If you enjoy engaging with clients—both face-to-face and through digital channels—have an entrepreneurial mindset, and are passionate about technology, this opportunity is for you. We value resilience, collaboration, and a sense of humour in our fast-paced sales environment. In return, we offer a competitive salary package, excellent benefits, and world-class training in a supportive environment that encourages growth. Join us and become a trusted advisor to your clients. Sales Prospecting & Lead Generation: Identify and target new business opportunities for Oracle Cloud solutions across multiple industries to ensure coverage of the assigned territory. Develop and execute outbound strategies to generate leads through customer engagement, networking, attending events, and leveraging digital channels. Qualify and prioritize leads to engage the most promising prospects for Oracle Cloud solutions. Create and continuously update account management plans within the defined territory. Consultative and Solution Selling: Engage with senior executives (C-level) as a trusted advisor to challenge conventional approaches and deliver transformative results. You will understand what motivates customers to buy and know how to tap into those needs in an effective way. Grow consumption on a quarter-on-quarter basis, by landing new customers and/or new workloads on a monthly-basis, maintaining performance metrics and contributing to sustained revenue growth. Build and implement key sales and business development initiatives to improve awareness of Oracle OCI and increase sales pipeline. Product Presentations & Demos: Master and share the “Why Oracle Story” that represents the value Oracle provides to customers with our unified, multi-pillar offerings. Prepare and deliver persuasive presentations and demonstrations of Oracle’s Cloud products and services. Work closely with technical teams to deliver proof-of-concept trials and in-depth product demos, showcasing the value of Oracle's solutions. Leverage your and Oracle’s expertise to deliver world-class Cloud solutions, that highlight OCI’s unique benefits and capabilities across Compute (GPU/Non-GPU), Networking, Cloud Native Development and AI, to drive transformative outcomes. Sales Negotiation & Deal Closure: Lead the negotiation process, addressing customer objections and aligning contract terms with Oracle’s offerings (cloud subscriptions and perpetual licenses). Work with legal, finance, and technical teams in a timely manner to ensure that proposals, contracts, and renewals are delivered and closed out successfully. Close deals and meet or exceed revenue targets, quotas and KPI’s. Relationship Management & Account Development: Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within the customer base to drive incremental revenue. Provide ongoing customer support during and after the sales process, ensuring smooth implementation and adoption of Oracle cloud solutions. Collaboration with Internal Teams: Work collaboratively with Oracle’s technical, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure seamless pre-sales and post-sales experiences. Provide timely feedback to Oracle product teams regarding customer requirements and market trends to inform product enhancements. Coordinate with marketing to actively execute campaigns and promotions for the target market of Oracle cloud prospects. Work collaboratively with Technology Cloud Data Platform sales team and all other LOB’s to maximise customer success and drive adoption of Oracle products and services. Partnering Build strong and growth-oriented relationships with clients and partners to foster trust, collaboration, and long-term mutual success by understanding their needs and offering tailored solutions. Identify and build relationship with partners that influence customers within your territory and leverage Oracle’s partner team where appropriate. Sales Pipeline & Forecast Management: Actively progress the pipeline through sales stages throughout the quarter. Manage an active sales pipeline in CRM tools and provide accurate and timely updates on sales opportunities, forecasts, and activities. Monitor pipeline progress and adjust sales strategies as needed to ensure sales objectives are met. Regularly report sales metrics, progress, and achievements to senior management. Identify and pursue new clients while expanding opportunities within existing accounts by understanding their needs and offering tailored solutions. Career Level
- IC5

title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobDescription:
In this role, you will: Architect, design, and operate distributed, highly available, and resilient systems for multi-tenant, horizontally scalable, and cost-efficient architectures that deliver consistent latency, throughput, and durability across OCI regions. Collaborate cross-functionally with Compute, Storage, Networking, OKE and functions to deliver new platform features focusing on compute and control plane services, enforce secure-by-default designs, and improve overall services reliability. Mentor and guide engineers in distributed systems design, high-scale data processing, and operational excellence; set and raise engineering standards across multiple teams. Drive operational excellence by owning service-level objectives (availability, latency, durability) and reducing toil through automation, observability, and self-healing mechanisms. Own the full service lifecycle from design and implementation to deployment, on-call, and continuous improvement — maintaining high code and reliability standards. Define and drive the technical roadmap for compute and control plane services. Partner with product management and field teams to translate customer needs into roadmap priorities. Contribute to the broader Compute vision, influencing how compute Services evolve to support mission-critical workloads globally.

QUALIFICATIONS:
12+ years of development experience with large scale, highly available distributed systems Proficiency in Java programming patterns, programming experience with Scala, Python is preferred. Advanced knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and operating systems. Experience with operating distributed services at scale Expertise in Linux and operating systems Systematic problem-solving approach, strong communication skills, strong ownership and drive Deep understanding of service metrics and alarms through the development of dashboards, service KPIs, alarming systems Ability to propose, scope, design and direct automation, optimizations, and enhancements BS or MS degree in Computer Science/Engineering or a related IT field or equivalent experience relevant to functional area. Soft Skills & Leadership Proven ability to drive technical outcomes, take ownership of deliverables, and work independently in fast-evolving AI solution spaces. Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and document solution approaches, collaborate across multiple geo distributed teams. Demonstrated problem-solving ability leveraging AI, distributed systems, and cloud-native application behaviors. A proactive, experimentation-oriented mindset with a strong willingness to learn and guide team on emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and engineering patterns. We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer with technical depth and breadth, proven experience in solving cloud scale problems, distributed systems design & implementation experience to build fault tolerant solutions that will form the foundations of the next generation of Compute offerings. The candidate is expected to have strong written and verbal communications skills, the ability to lead projects across organizational boundaries, and experience representing their work to senior leaders. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Compute delivers bare metal and virtual machine instances
- CPU and GPU -at global scale. We are hiring a Consulting Member of Technical Staff to provide hands-on technical leadership for OCI compute control plane services. You will architect and deliver distributed systems that are multi-tenant, highly available, and horizontally scalable across OCI regions, while driving operational excellence and cross-team technical alignment. As a member of the software engineering division, you will take an active role in the definition and evolution of standard practices and procedures. Define specifications for significant new projects and specify, design and develop software according to those specifications. You will perform professional software development tasks associated with the developing, designing and debugging of software applications or operating systems. Career Level
- IC5

title: Principal Product Manager
jobDescription:

The Oracle APEX Product Management team is looking for an experienced Product Manager to lead the development of Oracle APEX product collateral: training courseware, certification programs, tutorials, Live Labs, videos, and customer-facing enablement content, that fuels product adoption and customer success worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise and compelling content craft, You'll turn product capabilities and new feature releases into materials that customers, partners, and internal teams rely on every day to succeed with Oracle APEX. Beyond collateral development, you'll be a driving force behind customer and partner engagements, proof-of-concepts, University, and community and event programs, partnering closely with Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, Cloud Engineering, and Partners to accelerate Oracle APEX adoption globally. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. 5–10+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Marketing, Developer Relations, Customer Success, Sales, Solution Engineering, or Technical Consulting. Strong Oracle Database expertise, including SQL, PL/SQL, relational database design, and data modeling. Hands-on experience with Oracle APEX application development. Proven experience creating technical documentation, training content, tutorials, videos, or other customer-facing enablement material. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences. Experience working directly with enterprise customers, partners, and developer communities, including planning and executing events, workshops, or webinars. Strong project management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple initiatives and stakeholders in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Familiarity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is a plus. Oracle APEX is powering the next generation of enterprise AI applications, and we are looking for someone to show the world how. Do you have a passion for creating engaging product collateral including training materials, demos, hands-on labs, workshops, white papers, and videos that showcase the power of Oracle APEX? Join some of the brightest minds in the ecosystem, help grow our global developer community, and shape the future of enterprise AI application development. We're excited to welcome you on board! Responsibilities Product Collateral Development (Primary Focus) Lead the creation and continuous evolution of Oracle APEX product collateral: training courseware, certification programs, tutorials, Live Labs, videos, and other high-impact enablement content. Partner closely with Engineering and Sales to ensure every piece of content reflects the platform's latest capabilities and feature releases with precision and clarity. Craft customer success stories, blogs, and advocacy content that bring real-world Oracle APEX impact to life, in collaboration with Marketing, customers, and partners. Build and maintain a content roadmap tied to the product release cycle. Champion Oracle APEX hosted environments used for demos, workshops, and customer engagements, ensuring they're always ready to make a strong impression. title: Director, Platform Software Engineering
jobDescription:
My SQL Server Core Engineering develops the foundational database capabilities that enable My SQL to deliver high performance, reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence for open-source users, enterprise customers, and cloud services. As a Director, you will lead a broad Core Engineering organization responsible for critical database-server technology. You will set technical and organizational strategy, establish roadmap and investment priorities, develop engineering leaders and talent, and partner across product, cloud-service, and engineering organizations to deliver strategic customer and business outcomes. This role requires an accomplished engineering leader with deep experience in database systems or comparable infrastructure software. You will guide complex architectural and execution decisions while balancing innovation with the compatibility, quality, security, and operational standards expected of a mature, globally deployed database platform. You will also help advance My SQL as a more contribution-driven open-source project through strong technical stewardship, clear architecture, high engineering standards, effective contributor workflows, and community collaboration. Lead My SQL Server Core Engineering, shaping the database technology that powers a globally used open-source platform and supports Oracle’s cloud database offerings. Set direction for high-impact investments in performance, reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience. Key Responsibilities Platform Software Development Set the multi-year technical and organisational strategy for My SQL Server Core Engineering, aligning database-platform investments with product strategy, cloud-service priorities, customer needs, and open-source commitments. Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for foundational database capabilities, including areas such as data management, query processing, transactions, concurrency, replication, security, performance, reliability, and operational tooling. Establish organisational standards for compatibility, security, scalability, resilience, upgrade-ability, and operational readiness across the core database platform. Make or sponsor high-impact technical decisions involving architectural direction, major migrations, compatibility commitments, lifecycle management, and long-term technology investments. Shape My SQL’s evolution as a contribution-driven open-source project by sponsoring improvements in architecture, developer experience, governance, contribution workflows, technical documentation, and community collaboration. Software Development and Coding, Design, Testing, and Optimization Establish the engineering vision, quality bar, and execution model for complex database-server development across the organization. Ensure teams deliver software that meets demanding requirements for correctness, performance, scalability, reliability, security, compatibility, and maintainability. Sponsor major architecture, design, and specification reviews; ensure technical decisions align with strategic product outcomes and long-term platform health. Drive organization-wide investment in engineering excellence, including automated testing, performance validation, diagnostics, observability, developer productivity, release readiness, and defect prevention. Guide leaders in managing technical trade-offs across feature delivery, customer impact, operational risk, security, compatibility, and technical debt. Ensure engineering teams maintain clear, stable, and well-governed interfaces across database components, services, tools, and supported integrations. Software Architecture, Software System Structural Design Own the architectural direction and long-term technical health of the My SQL Server Core Engineering portfolio. Lead senior technical and engineering leaders in defining architecture principles, reviewing complex designs, and ensuring consistent technical standards across teams. Drive strategic modernisation and simplification initiatives that improve platform scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and development velocity. Partner with product, cloud-service, security, and other engineering leaders to align architecture decisions with business priorities, customer requirements, and future market needs. Establish effective mechanisms for technology evaluation, architecture governance, technical-debt management, and investment prioritization. Ensure that the organization makes timely, high-quality decisions on complex technical issues with broad product, customer, or business impact. Issue/Defect Collaboration, Software Products Support Provide executive technical leadership for high-impact customer, production, performance, availability, security, and product-quality issues. Partner with product, cloud-service, support, and engineering leaders to establish clear escalation paths, decision mechanisms, and communication practices for critical issues. Ensure teams deliver timely mitigation, root-cause analysis, durable corrective actions, and systemic prevention for broadly impactful issues. Use customer feedback, operational evidence, and issue trends to guide quality investments, architectural improvements, and roadmap prioritization. Represent the organization in executive-level discussions on major customer issues, technical risk, product commitments, and strategic remediation plans. Practices and Standards Compliance, Security and Compliance Set and enforce organizational expectations for secure software development, data protection, engineering quality, regulatory alignment, and operational risk management. Ensure leaders establish and maintain appropriate security, compliance, privacy, code-quality, release, and operational standards across their teams. Sponsor proactive identification and remediation of systemic technical, security, compatibility, and reliability risks. Partner with security, compliance, legal, and cloud-service leaders to ensure core database technologies meet applicable enterprise and service requirements. Promote a culture of technical accountability, rigorous review, clear documentation, and continuous improvement. Development Operations, System Maintenance Ensure the organization maintains strong operational discipline for software maintenance, lifecycle support, upgrades, patching, release readiness, and incident response. Set expectations for reliable operational practices, including automation, testing, observability, diagnostics, performance management, and service-health improvement. Lead investments that strengthen product availability, supportability, upgradeability, and operational efficiency across the database platform. Ensure lessons from customer issues, production incidents, and service operations are incorporated into product strategy, engineering practices, and technology roadmaps. Core Responsibilities Planning & Execution Set the strategic roadmap, investment priorities, operating model, and delivery expectations for the My SQL Server Core Engineering organization. Lead multiple teams through complex, interdependent initiatives; ensure clear ownership, realistic milestones, effective resource allocation, and proactive risk management. Balance short-term product and cloud-service commitments with sustained investment in architecture, quality, security, performance, reliability, technical debt, and open-source ecosystem health. Provide senior leadership with transparent visibility into roadmap progress, material risks, investment trade-offs, staffing needs, and decisions requiring executive alignment. Collaboration & Partnership Build strong partnerships with senior leaders across engineering, product management, cloud services, support, security, and the open-source ecosystem. Align cross-functional organizations on shared roadmap outcomes, technical dependencies, customer commitments, and strategic investments. Represent My SQL Server Core Engineering in senior-level planning, architecture, product, and business discussions. Create an organizational culture that encourages constructive challenge, diverse technical perspectives, clear decision-making, and shared accountability for outcomes. Problem Solving Lead resolution of the organization’s most complex and consequential technical, operational, customer, and business challenges. Provide strategic judgment and direction when decisions require balancing customer impact, delivery commitments, technical risk, organizational capacity, and long-term platform health. Ensure leaders use rigorous analysis, system-level understanding, and root-cause methods to address issues and prevent recurrence. Drive systemic improvements where recurring issues indicate architectural, process, capability, or operating-model gaps. Continuous Learning Maintain strategic awareness of database systems, cloud platforms, open-source ecosystems, customer needs, and industry technology trends. Build an organization that continuously develops technical depth, leadership capability, domain knowledge, and cross-functional understanding. Identify critical skill gaps and establish talent-development, hiring, knowledge-sharing, and succession strategies for specialized database and systems expertise. Encourage leaders to create learning opportunities that strengthen innovation, technical judgment, engineering effectiveness, and organizational resilience. Continuous Improvement Lead a sustained improvement agenda across architecture, engineering quality, delivery practices, developer productivity, operational excellence, and contributor experience. Prioritize improvement investments based on customer impact, strategic value, technical risk, organizational scalability, and long-term return. Establish mechanisms to measure engineering effectiveness, identify systemic bottlenecks, and drive accountable improvements across teams. Advance My SQL’s contribution-driven open-source model through strong technical stewardship, transparent development practices, maintainable design, and effective engagement with contributors. Performance and Development Build and lead a high-performing leadership organization through clear expectations, coaching, talent development, accountability, and succession planning. Develop managers and senior technical leaders who can independently lead complex technology areas, make sound decisions, and build strong teams. Establish a talent strategy that attracts, retains, and develops specialists in database systems, systems software, cloud technologies, and open-source engineering. Ensure consistent, equitable performance management, promotion, recognition, and career-development practices across the organization. Partner with Human Resources and senior leadership to plan organizational capability, leadership succession, and workforce needs in support of long-term strategy. Career Level
- M4

Oracle Hospitality delivers technology solutions that help hotels, resorts, restaurants, and food & beverage businesses operate efficiently and enhance guest experiences globally. The Oracle Hospitality Support organization partners with customers worldwide to provide 24x7 support for mission-critical hospitality systems, including OPERA PMS and related hotel technology platforms. This role sits within the Oracle Hospitality Support team focused on providing first-level technical and functional support for the Oracle Hospitality OPERA product suite and associated hotel interfaces. title: Principal Database Performance Engineer
jobDescription:
About the Team Join Oracle's cutting-edge Data Platform team, where innovation meets scale. We build and support high-performance, enterprise-grade database solutions that power mission-critical applications for customers across the globe. Our team partners closely with Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Support to solve complex database performance challenges while ensuring exceptional scalability, reliability, and availability. We thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment focused on delivering world-class database performance for enterprise workloads. Role Overview As a Principal Site Reliability Developer, you will play a critical role in improving the performance, scalability, and reliability of Oracle Database environments supporting enterprise-scale applications. This role is primarily focused on Performance Engineering, where you will analyse complex production workloads, investigate database performance issues, optimize SQL execution, and drive proactive performance improvements across large-scale Oracle environments. You will work closely with engineering teams to diagnose performance bottlenecks across SQL, PL/SQL, database architecture, and application interactions. While experience with PL/SQL development is essential, it is primarily required to optimize existing database logic and improve application performance rather than build new database applications. Who Will Be an Ideal Fit You are an experienced Oracle Database Performance Engineer with a passion for solving complex performance problems at scale. You have deep expertise in Oracle database internals, SQL optimization, execution plan analysis, and production performance diagnostics. You enjoy investigating challenging database issues, identifying root causes, and implementing scalable performance improvements. You possess strong analytical skills, excellent troubleshooting abilities, and a customer-first mindset. Why You Should Accept This

ROLE:
Work on Oracle Database technologies including Oracle 19c, 21c, and 23ai Solve complex database performance challenges for enterprise customers Influence performance improvements across mission-critical production systems Collaborate with world-class Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams Gain exposure to distributed databases, large-scale workloads, and cloud-native architectures Continuous learning opportunities in Oracle Database technologies and Performance Engineering Must-Have Skills: Strong SQL tuning and performance optimization skills (AWR/ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, SQL Trace, TKPROF, Performance Diagnostics, Root Cause Analysis, Explain Plans, Optimizer Hints) Experience with partitioning, Indexing, materialized views, and analytical functions Deep understanding of Oracle Optimizer and Cost-Based Optimization Hands-on experience with PL/SQL development and Oracle database internals Expertise in Oracle versions 19c, 21c, and 23ai Proficiency in programming languages such as C, C++, Java, or Python Experience with relational and No SQL databases (e.g., Mongo DB, Cassandra) Knowledge of distributed databases, sharding, and massively parallel processing systems Experience with high availability, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery strategies Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across database and application layers Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Nice-to-Have Skills: Experience with internet-scale applications Familiarity with Oracle Globally Distributed Database Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Exposure to Dev Ops practices and tools such as Terraform Experience writing and publishing technical white papers Solve complex problems related to infrastructure cloud services and build automation to prevent problem recurrence. Design, write, and deploy software to improve the availability, scalability, and efficiency of Oracle products and services. Design and develop designs, architectures, standards, and methods for large-scale distributed systems. Facilitate service capacity planning and demand forecasting, software performance analysis, and system tuning. Responsibilities Lead database performance engineering initiatives across large-scale Oracle environments. Analyze and troubleshoot complex SQL performance issues using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and execution plan analysis. Perform root cause analysis for production performance incidents and recommend long-term solutions. Identify performance bottlenecks across SQL, PL/SQL, database architecture, memory, storage, and application interactions. Optimize SQL execution plans, indexing strategies, optimizer statistics, and database configurations. Conduct proactive database health assessments and performance reviews. Perform workload analysis and capacity planning for enterprise systems. Drive continuous improvements in database scalability, stability, and performance. Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure applications are designed for optimal database performance. Recommend best practices around SQL coding standards and database performance optimization. Work with customers, partners, and internal teams (sales, support) to drive successful product adoption Design, develop, and maintain complex Oracle database objects including packages, procedures, functions, and triggers using PL/SQL Architect and implement efficient database schemas to support both transactional and analytical workloads Develop demos and technical showcases to highlight product capabilities Troubleshoot and debug issues across databases, applications, and related systems Support high availability, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in enterprise environments Career Level
- IC4

Experience building enterprise-scale Saa S platforms. Proven experience delivering large features from design through production. Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple teams. Strong understanding of software architecture and system design. Experience leveraging AI-assisted development workflows and productivity tools. Healthcare payer platform experience. title: Senior Platform Software Engineer (Date Engineering)
jobDescription:
Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Key Responsibilities Platform Software Development: Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use. Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans. Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers. Software Development and Coding
- Design, Testing, and Optimization: Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently. Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle. Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code. Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements. Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues. Implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process. Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding. Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration. Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies. Software Architecture
- Software System Structural Design: Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices. Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture. Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design. Issue/Defect Collaboration
- Software Products Support: Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions. May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently. Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback. Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication. - Security and Compliance: Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards. Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development. Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes. Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities. Development Operations
- System Maintenance: Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities). title: Senior Application Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Oracle Health group is on a mission to bring the modern health care technology platform to provide better health insights and human-centric experiences for patients, providers, payers, and the public. In this role, you will drive end-to-end data architecture across ingestion, transformation, storage, and access layers, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise and regulatory requirements. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and cross-functional teams to modernize ETL pipelines and transform complex legacy data workloads into efficient, cloud-native solutions. You will be responsible for defining and developing software for tasks associated with the developing, designing, and debugging software applications or operating systems . This is a rare opportunity to make a meaningful impact in society while working in a dynamic and flexible workplace where you'll belong and be encouraged. As a Senior Application Software Engineer, you will own the software design and development for major components of Oracle's Cloud Infrastructure. You should be both a solid coder and a distributed systems generalist, able to dive deep into any part of the stack and low-level systems and design broad distributed system interactions. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. This is a high-impact position focused on delivering reliable, high-performance analytics platforms that enable critical insights while maintaining strict standards for security, compliance, and operational excellence. We're looking for highly skilled experienced engineers to design and build high-scale, cloud-based data processing systems that can handle massive amounts of data with low latency. Around 4+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise-scale applications using Full Stack Development , with a strong focus on Analytics , Cloud-based Big Data Solutions , and Low-Code/No-Code platforms . Strong background in developing and maintaining high-scale front-end and back-end services within Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) environments. Proven experience in software design, architecture, and code quality , with active participation in architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews to ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance. Familiarity with integrating AI-powered solutions into enterprise applications, analytics platforms, and cloud-based ecosystems is considered a strong advantage. Deep understanding of operational excellence , including monitoring, reliability engineering, and improving SLI/SLO metrics across distributed systems. Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and/or Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) is highly desirable (but not mandatory). Ability to create and communicate technical concepts effectively through technical proposals, design documents, architecture diagrams, and presentations . Capable of working independently while driving technical initiatives and solving complex engineering challenges. Experience mentoring and providing technical guidance to junior engineers , fostering knowledge sharing and engineering best practices. Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to lead by example , promote accountability, recognize team achievements, and cultivate a collaborative and respectful work environment. Career Level
- IC3
